target.description: Model number of trials until conditioned responding across ITIs 30, 60, 300, 600 and 3,600 seconds. This source model endpoint is one part of the paper’s behavior/dopamine learning claims.

dataset.description: Author Figure 5 selects five-condition experimental NWB observations and simulation summaries; exact immutable DANDI release and behavior-summary manifest remain to bind.

cohort.description: Original learning-analysis animals and source learner filtering must be recovered for all five ITIs; the local 38-mouse 60/600-second component is not the full comparison.

split.description: The recovered original fit uses all five experimental ITIs with models_to_exclude=0, fitting and comparing the same observations. It is not animal-held-out generalization; any new holdout is an extension.

inputs.description: Original reward/cue schedules, animal learning summaries and the declared model simulation procedures. Source cached summaries are reconstruction outputs, not candidate prediction inputs.

preprocessing.description: Source Figure 5 uses learner selection and 37-second windows with seven-second baseline; behavior_fit averages simulation iterations and censors TDRL predictions using source trial caps [800,400,88,48,16]. Complete learning-threshold, animal and source-summary mapping must be authenticated.

metric.description: Selection RSS sums (log observed trials-to-learn − log mean predicted trials-to-learn)^2, omitting NaNs and assigning infinite loss to missing predictions. Reported AIC instead uses nAnimals×log(raw-scale mean squared error)+2k. These are different ordered metrics; the main source comparison uses k=0 with alternative penalties also calculated.

aggregation.description: Source RSS/AIC aggregate experimental animal observations across the five ITIs against model predictions averaged over simulation iterations. Simulation seeds/iterations are not biological replicates.

full_panel.description: Preserve the registered original behavioral/dopamine learning programme, not only the 60/600-second reconstruction or five-ITI AIC scalar: original five-ITI behavior, 60/600/3600 dopamine, model comparisons and all required companions in Figures 1-8, Extended Data 1-10, Supplementary Note 1 and Table 1, including corrected Fig4b, histology/exclusion mapping, onset/peak sensitivities, aversive spacing, four alternative-explanation controls, partial reinforcement, omission timing and model extensions. Complete immutable animal/session/model/figure membership and source-native curve/parameter outputs are not authenticated.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions use the same original paper/correction and authenticated source observations: NWB event logs and task parameters, original permitted processed photometry, original reward/cue/omission schedules, full animal/session identities and source model simulation protocols. Author code at the source revision is the sole added information in paper_data_author_code. Learning summaries, selected model predictions, source reference arrays and published aggregates are known outputs/targets, not substitute evidence of input-dependent computation. Preserve public exposure and the original in-sample model selection; a new animal holdout or altered schedule is an extension.

Most original scalar targets, full timecourses, coefficients and source Supplementary Table 1 values have not been numerically authenticated; printed targets retained here are known allowed inputs, not reproduction evidence.

Native log-RSS model selection and raw-scale AIC/AICc must remain distinct; source simulation NaNs propagate, raw-MSE residual count can differ from source nAnimals, and all original families/conditions/iterations must be retained.

Source microstimulus censoring uses MATLAB Cartesian row/column indexing, and the k0 relative-likelihood minimum omits ordinary microstimulus TD; these source hazards require native parity and a predeclared branch decision, not silent elementwise clipping or renormalization.

Corrected Fig4b coordinates, fiber-placement/cohort discrepancies, learner/exclusion differences, photometry normalization clocks, extreme-ITI crops, partial-reinforcement event counters and the 10% exclusion-scope discrepancy remain unresolved.

The runnable five-ITI scorer consumes prepared observation/simulation tensors and tests metric arithmetic only; it does not independently derive or authenticate those tensors from raw source data, and does not execute biological or model companion analyses.

The historical 60/600 registered bridge is scoped evidence with external runtime dependencies and cannot establish full-panel reproduction; matching its scores or copying source aggregates is insufficient.

No complete trusted verifier, authenticated granular-output identities, full-panel evaluator, original input manifest, paired exposure protocol or cumulative episode budgets exist; optional admission_policy and both paired protocols are omitted/unresolved rather than filled with invented hashes.

No source-grounded reproduction tolerances, deterministic equivalence rules, confidence levels or independent-unit minima have been frozen. Source SEM/p-values and nonrejection are not reproduction criteria; model iterations are not animal replicates.
